typography.displayFamily: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif
typography.displayStyle: Measured editorial headings with a compact sans-serif utility layer.
typography.scale: 1.125 modular scale with fluid display sizing.

layout.hero: Text-led asymmetric hero with one decisive action.
layout.grid: 12-column desktop rhythm that collapses to one reading column.
layout.imageTreatment: No image required; use approved, rights-cleared imagery only when it adds truth.

motion.character: Short opacity and color transitions only; no ambient motion.
motion.reducedMotion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no essential information depends on animation.

visualAcceptanceTests: Private desktop and iPhone screenshots are captured when Playwright is configured.
